description: Fetch and clean the full text of an official Belgian or European legal document (HTML or PDF) from a URL on the allowlist of official sources (e.g. ejustice.just.fgov.be, eur-lex.europa.eu). Capped at 30,000 characters. Pair with legal_lookup / eurlex_lookup to get the URL first.

url.description: Document URL on an allowed official domain.
url.title: Url

name: legal_read
title: Read an official legal text
